text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
(This weekend, I am to join my classmates to try what they call
a “limited-time menu” item of ‘Hachimi’...
Such promises are quite thrilling...)

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: (This engagement is... one I cannot miss...)

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
("Let's go another time"... was it?
I am truly blessed with generous classmates.
Blessed, and yet............)

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: This bitter frustration... I cannot shake it off...
